chunks: If he is unable to provide the feeding, he should give charity according to what he is capable of.

key_terms.الْإِطْعَامِ: the feeding of others as an expiatory obligation
key_terms.رُوِيَ: it is narrated; a report transmitted without a stated sanad here
key_terms.يُطِيقُ: he is able or capable of

ai.seo_question: What should a person do in ẓihār expiation if he cannot afford the required feeding?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for one who cannot fulfill the required feeding in the context of ẓihār expiation. In such a case, he is to give charity in accordance with his financial ability, reflecting ease and proportional responsibility in the Sacred Law.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "If he is unable to provide the required feeding (it'ām), he should give charity (ṣadaqah) according to what he is capable of."
